view: Close architectural study Niya in Taklamakan exposed timber house frame upright posts jointed sill and surviving woven reed wall base, sand drifting through doorway, detailed wood grain, low dunes beyond, no roof or green oasis.

eras.title: The frame of a house
eras.caption: Niya's dry climate preserved wooden posts, woven reed walls and documents written on wooden tablets. These remains reveal an oasis community of houses, orchards and irrigated fields along a river that no longer reaches the settlement.
